technical_facts: Implemented fixes for network play issues in early 1996
Modified monster AI so they no longer activate platforms
Added 'shambler shoot up' functionality
Implemented 'stubbed enforcer' and soldier standing frames
Changed monster use function to make them hostile towards the activator
Implemented 'drop ammo' and 'negative ammo' logic
Added extra friction near edges to improve movement
Corrected fractional calculations (fracs) for single player mode
Implemented 'use monsters = wake up' logic
Set ideal yaw upon first sighting for AI
Implemented temporary object updates
Added size checks for teleport destinations
Created player-only teleporters
Added visual effects: puff of smoke when shooters fire
Implemented 'step on grenades' trigger
Added 'flyers look down' behavior
Added an 'eagle eye' checkbox option
Implemented height changes for flying entities
Implemented monster jumping
Created 'tents' for shotgun puffs (visual optimization/clipping)
Addressed a stability issue where leaving the level running too long caused problems
Adjusted Shambler range
personality_patterns: Iterative approach to game development (fixing, adding, tweaking)
High attention to detail regarding game feel (e.g., friction near edges, visual puffs)

gnosis_principles.description: The process of continuously polishing small details (like friction, visual effects, and AI behavior) to improve the overall user experience.
Identifying and fixing specific failure points, such as teleport destination size checks and level stability over time.

heritage_patterns: Fast-paced iterative development cycle typical of id Software's early era
Focus on low-level optimization and precise entity behavior
Separation of network play logic from single-player mechanics

dpo_pairs.prompt: What changes were made to monster AI in the March 1996 plan?
dpo_pairs.chosen: Monsters were modified so they no longer activate platforms, they now set an ideal yaw upon first sighting, and their use function makes them hostile towards the activator.
dpo_pairs.rejected: The monsters were generally improved to be more difficult for the player.

dpo_pairs.prompt: How did Carmack handle teleportation safety in this update?
dpo_pairs.chosen: He implemented a size check on teleport destinations to ensure the entity fits.
dpo_pairs.rejected: He made teleporters only work for players.
